spanish: Y el SEÑOR de los ejércitos, que juzga con justicia, que prueba los riñones y el corazón, me ha mostrado tu venganza de ellos, porque a mí me has revelado tu pleito.

findings.issue: Spanish inverts speaker as recipient ('me ha mostrado') instead of 1cs imperfect 'I see/let me see'
Spanish changes 1cs perfect 'I have revealed' to 2ms 'me has revelado'
Spanish renders 1cs suffix 'my plea' as 'tu pleito' (2ms)
Spanish 'tu venganza de ellos' misplaces the 2ms suffix and preposition from the tokens

notes: participant reversal and person/number changes on multiple verbs and suffixes
